name: naxasware-plugins
description: Naxasware's official Claude Code plugin marketplace — one plugin per folder under plugins/.

plugins.name: ai-requirements-analyst
plugins.description: Evidence-based requirements engineering — turns ideas, docs, and connected repos/DBs/APIs into structured, implementation-ready requirements, and verifies documented requirements.

plugins.name: ai-system-architect
plugins.description: Designs, reviews and modernizes software architecture from business requirements and real technical evidence (repository, docs, database, APIs, infrastructure), with explicit trade-offs, ADRs, risks and diagrams. Read-only by default and useful without any tools.
